task: next-hour container_dwell_hours regression, one sample per (port, hour t)

y.meaning: dwell at hour t+1, per-port z-score (scalers.json['dwell'])

y_hours.meaning: dwell at hour t+1 in hours (for evaluation)

last_dwell_hours.meaning: dwell at hour t in hours

port_index.meaning: index into ports (for an embedding / per-port de-scaling)

target_hour_index.meaning: global hour index of the target (0 = 2025-01-01 00:00 UTC)

features.name: dwell
features.definition: Average container dwell time at the port in hour t (also the target, one hour later).

features.name: utilization
features.definition: Throughput / capacity in hour t; censored at 100 when the port is saturated.

features.name: labour_strike
features.definition: 1 if labour_status == 'strike' in hour t ('reduced' carries no signal and is treated as 0).

features.name: wind_gust
features.definition: Maximum 10 m wind gust in hour t; 2 negative values clipped to 0.

features.name: disruption_active
features.definition: 1 if a logged disruption is ongoing at hour t.

features.name: disruption_hours_elapsed
features.definition: Hours since the ongoing disruption episode began (earliest start among overlapping ongoing events); 0 if none.

features.name: vessels_at_anchor
features.definition: Vessels waiting at anchor in hour t.

excluded_features.throughput_teu: exact multiple of utilization (utilization = throughput / capacity x 100); port-specific scale
excluded_features.customs_hold_hours: hour-to-hour white noise, no relation to next-hour dwell (audit partial r 0.01); most reconstructed signal (6.1 %)
excluded_features.temperature_2m_c: no within-port relation to next-hour dwell (audit partial r 0.05)
excluded_features.equipment_availability_pct: no measurable next-hour signal (audit partial r -0.00)
excluded_features.wind_speed_10m_kmh: replaced by wind gusts (r = 0.98, same signal)
excluded_features.port_traffic_history: daily aggregate of the same telemetry; same-day values leak later hours

reconstructed_input_policy.values: kept exactly as in Dataset/Processed; not re-imputed (re-imputation would invent new values or use the future)
reconstructed_input_policy.flag: provenance == 2 marks a value with no raw observation; provenance == 1 marks a raw value after a unit/format fix
reconstructed_input_policy.default_model_input: X concatenated with the dwell reconstructed flag (provenance[..., 0] == 2) -> [N, 12, 8]; see dataset.load_split
reconstructed_input_policy.sensitivity: windows.csv n_reconstructed_input_cells == 0 selects windows with fully observed inputs

target_policy: windows whose target hour is reconstructed are excluded from training and evaluation
